correctness.rationale: For each local Artinian factor, a nonzero socle element annihilates its maximal ideal. The coordinate-supported socle elements form a total-dominating clique of size k. Published Artinian domination gives the lower bound k in the stated nonreduced nonlocal domain. Paired domination must be even and at least total domination; the clique itself matches when k is even, and one explicit two-coordinate zero-divisor gives a size k+1 paired witness when k is odd.

value.rationale: The theorem determines a standard strengthened domination invariant on the full nonreduced nonlocal Artinian class. It shows that all nilpotent thickness, residue-field sizes, and local ideal-lattice details are invisible to paired domination; only the factor count and its parity survive. The explicit socle-clique mechanism explains this rigidity.
